$comment: Records what the certified SHA 23d5d7e10b389f98054587c09f44ee846be8172e actually does today.
PASS       = the contract holds at the certified SHA; a failure is a REGRESSION and fails CI.
KNOWN-OPEN = the contract does not hold at the certified SHA and the defect is recorded in
docs/g30/open-defect-register.md. Preparation documents these; it does not fix them.
Do not flip an entry to KNOWN-OPEN to silence a new failure. A newly failing check that was
baselined PASS means something regressed against the certified build, and that is the one
signal this suite exists to produce.
